unit.why: A single narrative about R. Simcha Bunem of Peshischa who gives his disciple R. Menachem Mendel (of Kotzk) spiritual 'levels', shown by a matchmaking episode in which the Kotzker's warning comes true.

stories.start_quote: עוד שמעתי שהיה אחד מגדולי תלמידיו
stories.end_quote: אמרתי לך שלא תעשה את השידוך
stories.summary_en: A disciple can see what R. Simcha Bunem is doing at home. R. Simcha Bunem decides to give that disciple's spiritual 'levels' to Menachem Mendel and Menachem Mendel's piety to the disciple. Menachem Mendel then warns a melamed against a rich match for his son, though the rebbe had approved it. The melamed goes ahead out of greed. After the rebbe's death the son reads secular books and is corrupted, and the melamed loses his money. In Kotzk the Kotzker explains that each tzaddik sees only as far as his own lifetime.
